messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick thread to capture the all-hands Qs about the reorg + Q3 hiring. Drop anything managers need clarified.

Ravi (ENG Manager - Runtime): Is the new runtime pod model changing headcount for my team? I heard were shifting two FTEs to a central pool.

Jonas (CTO): Correct  two engineer slots are pooled for cross-team infra work. That means your team loses two dedicated reqs but gains access to floaters for platform migrations. We expect net headcount to remain positive company-wide.

Sahil (VP Eng): Operational note: managers with pooled roles should still run interviews and recommend hires; the central team will sign off final placement within 7 days. Use the tag `POOL_RUNTIME_Q3` on GH reqs.

Ravi (ENG Manager - Runtime): What's the approval path if I want to keep the role on my team instead of pooling it?

Maya (People Ops): If you want to retain the slot, submit a 2-sentence business case and tag @Sahil + @Jonas. Theyll review within 5 business days.

Elliot (Recruiter): Sourcing heads-up: were prioritizing senior infra and platform engineers. Please set interviewer panels early and include at least one cross-team engineer for anyone tagged `POOL_*`.

Jonas (CTO): Messaging guidance for externally facing hires: say "targeted Q3 hiring in infra & platform". Avoid "reorg" in public job posts.

Maya (People Ops): I'll post a one-pager with: pool tags, approval SLAs, internal-transfer note, and onboarding template by tomorrow AM. DM me for urgent cases.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/q3-pool-and-reorg (doc id: 598)

Ravi (ENG Manager - Runtime): Thanks  that clears things up.
